subject: Interruption impact & request for remediation and credits
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena@luminos.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: devops@luminos.com
Date: 2027-03-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Production errors + severe latency during 2027-03-24 window

Hi Michael,

Heads up — we had a significant regression yesterday between 17:20–21:05 UTC where our live traffic saw elevated error rates (502/504) and median p99 latency spiked from ~210ms to ~3.2s. This affected approximately 18% of requests for our checkout flow and caused cascading retries and user-facing failures.

We attached a short sample of error responses and a trace that shows requests timing out while waiting for model responses. The outage window overlaps a high-traffic batch job, and our SREs had to throttle traffic and fail open to maintain availability.

This incident led to measurable revenue impact for us. We need:
- confirmation of root cause and impacted window (timestamps above)
- proposed remediation and steps to avoid recurrence
- goodwill remediation: service credit and a trial extension for the portion of traffic that was impacted (we are still in a 60-day evaluation).

Please advise next steps and point of contact for evidence required from our side.

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Director, Platform Engineering
Luminos

Attachment: error_samples.txt (log snippets, 10kb)
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena@luminos.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-25T09:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Production errors + severe latency during 2027-03-24 window

Hi Elena — thanks for the alert and the logs, and Im really sorry Luminos hit this. Monica (CS) and Rishi (SRE) are looped in; well pull the full telemetry and confirm the exact impacted window.

Preliminary notes:
- We see elevated tail latencies on the pod group serving your region during that interval.
- Ill escalate to billing/legal for a remediation proposal (credits + extension) so we can get something in writing quickly.

Can you confirm the expected usage we should look at for calculating a remediation amount (monthly spend or trial cap)? If youd prefer, we can schedule a 30m call today to align.

Ill follow up with a concrete credit proposal within the day after we validate telemetry.

—Michael
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

>
> Heads up — we had a significant regression yesterday between 17:20–21:05 UTC...
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-25T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Production errors + severe latency during 2027-03-24 window

Forwarding Luminos incident and initial logs. Monica/Rishi/Markus — quick summary and suggested action:

Observations from ops (Rishi):
- Confirmed elevated token processing times on model-pool A in us-west during 17:15–21:10 UTC.
- Root cause: a mis-scheduled maintenance job that ran concurrently with a heavy batched inference workload; the job triggered a transient I/O stall on the storage layer which delayed KV-cache loads and caused cascading queueing.
- Impact: ~18% of requests returned 502/504 or timeouts; average p99 latency rose to ~3.2s.

Customer asks: service credit for impacted window + trial extension (Luminos is in a 60-day eval).

Proposed remediation package (my call to move things):
- One-time goodwill credit equivalent to 40% of charges for the impacted window (or a flat $12.5k cap)
- 30-day trial extension on top of their existing evaluation window
- Offer a short technical review session (30m) with Rishi and their SREs to align on mitigation.

Attachments: incident_summary.pdf, usage_report.csv (attached here for approval).

Please reply with any constraints — Markus, do we need legal signoff for the $12.5k one-time? Monica, happy to let you craft tone to the customer.

—Michael

Attachment: incident_summary.pdf (summary and timeline)
Attachment: usage_report.csv (usage calc)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-25T11:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production errors + severe latency during 2027-03-24 window

Thanks for the summary. I reviewed the incident_summary and usage_report. Given the clear operator-triggered maintenance overlap and the business impact, I approve a one-time customer remediation. My ask: keep the remediation package tight and documented.

Approved package (authorization id MG-2027-031):
- One-time account credit: $12,500 applied to Luminos billing account (covers the impacted window up to the cap)
- Trial extension: 30 calendar days added to their evaluation period
- Deliverable: Approved credit note (attached) to be sent to the customer from Michael/Monica; include a brief remediation note and next steps for technical alignment.

Finance/lifecycle notes: please route the credit with code FIN-CR-2027-031 and CC billing@redwood.com when applied. Monica, feel free to soften the language when you send to the customer; keep me copied.

Markus Klein
Head of Legal & Finance Enablement
Redwood Inference

Attachment: approved_credit_note.pdf
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena@luminos.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-26T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Resolution: credit applied and 30-day trial extension

Hi Elena — thanks again for your patience while we validated the telemetry. We appreciate you surfacing the incident and Im sorry for the impact.

What weve done:
- Weve approved and applied a one-time credit of $12,500 against Luminos account (authorization id MG-2027-031). You should see this reflected on your next billing cycle; Ill confirm with billing and share the transaction ID when available.
- Weve granted a 30-day extension to your evaluation window, effective today. Monica will confirm the new expiration date.
- Rishi will run a 30m technical review with your SRE team to go over the timeline, the root cause (I/O stall + maintenance overlap), and mitigation patterns (staggered maintenance, KV-cache priming).

Attachments: approved_credit_note.pdf (formal credit note), incident_summary.pdf, usage_report.csv.

Next steps:
- Monica: will send the new expiry date and set up the 30m technical review.
- Michael: will confirm credit application transaction id with billing and follow up if any additional evidence is required.

Thanks again — we value Luminos as a partner and want to make this right.

Best,
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
